Description: Joey Rose Studio offers freelance artistic services by artist, illustrator, and muralist Joey Rose. Specializing in illustration, mural design/installation, and custom artwork, we collaborate closely with clients to bring their vision to life. Our services include: 1. Illustration: Captivating illustrations for products, publications, editorial work, and more. 2. Mural Design/Installation: Transforming spaces with stunning murals for streets, offices, cafes, and more. 3. Custom Artwork: Crafting bespoke pieces tailored to clients' preferences for homes, offices, or events. 4. Artistic Consulting: Providing guidance on art curation, creative direction, and visual branding. Staff Additional Comment: Art studio, office, mural supply storage. Unit 1
